categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, production, sales, and service of digital X-ray flat panel detectors, which are core components of digital X-ray imaging systems. Its product applications cover medical imaging (including general radiography, mammography, dynamic imaging, radiotherapy, dental CBCT, and veterinary diagnostics), industrial non-destructive testing, security inspection, and pet medical fields. The company also develops intelligent DR solutions and key components such as X-ray tubes, high-voltage generators, and collimators.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company masters core technologies including amorphous silicon TFT/PD design and manufacturing, cesium iodide scintillator evaporation and packaging, dynamic series high-level application technologies, AED technology, wired and wireless DAEC technology, intelligent collimators, and intelligent DR solutions. It independently produces high-precision components like cesium iodide scintillators via evaporation technology and integrates CMOS and IGZO sensor technologies. Production involves a mix of in-house manufacturing for critical processes and outsourced assembly for lower value-added steps.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include manufacturers of digital X-ray imaging systems serving hospitals, veterinary clinics, industrial enterprises, and security inspection agencies. The company serves domestic and international markets with end-users in medical diagnostics, pet healthcare, industrial defect detection, and security screening. Key markets include medical institutions, industrial inspection firms, and security departments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with expanding international presence through subsidiaries and sales centers in the United States, India, Japan, South Korea, Italy, Singapore, and Europe. It actively develops emerging markets in South America, Asia-Pacific, and the Middle East, supported by a global sales and service network.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the digital X-ray imaging supply chain, focusing on the design and manufacturing of flat panel detectors and key imaging components. It supplies these critical parts to downstream digital X-ray system integrators and manufacturers. The company also extends upstream by designing and licensing TFT/PD technologies and scintillator production equipment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening innovation in digital X-ray flat panel detectors, expanding into intelligent DR solutions, and advancing CMOS and metal oxide sensor technologies. The company invests steadily in R&D (~16% of revenue), focusing on new product development such as wireless high-speed dynamic detectors, intelligent collimators, photon counting detectors, and advanced X-ray sources. It pursues global market expansion, supply chain optimization, and integration of imaging hardware and software.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of digital X-ray flat panel detectors, key components, and intelligent imaging solutions. The company sells directly and through distributors to domestic and international customers. It also earns income from customized product development and after-sales services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company ranks among the top global players in digital X-ray flat panel detectors, holding approximately 3% global market share in medical and veterinary segments and second place domestically. It competes with established international firms such as Varex, Trixell, Canon, and Fujifilm. The company leverages its technological innovation and cost advantages to increase market penetration and drive import substitution in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 274 million, a 33.8% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 15.4 million, reversing prior losses. It maintains a solid asset base near RMB 947 million and continues to invest heavily in R&D. The company shows a positive growth trajectory supported by expanding product lines and market reach.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes advanced technology leadership with proprietary cesium iodide evaporation processes, high-yield TFT/PD manufacturing, and integrated intelligent imaging solutions. Its products offer high resolution, low radiation dose, and broad application coverage from medical to industrial fields. The company differentiates through comprehensive product portfolios, customization capabilities, cost-effective production, and global service networks.
